title: pdr_core Proposal.target_position_pct + Fill.fill_price/fill_size_pct accept a bool (same bool-subclass-of-int hole av1 fixed only on AnalystView): False passes _on_ladder, True passes isfinite+>0 — a bool slips into the SIZED-DECISION + REACTION contracts
description:
VERIFIED (av1 critique, numeric). av1 fixed AnalystView's bool hole but left the sibling contracts: Proposal.__post_init__ (contracts.py:225) only calls _on_ladder (False==0.0 snaps to ladder rung 0.0), and Fill.__post_init__ (:273) only checks isfinite+>0 (True is finite & >0). So Proposal(target_position_pct=False) and Fill(fill_price=True, fill_size_pct=False) construct — a bool slips into the SIZED-DECISION (Proposal, the shell executes against it) + REACTION-feedback (Fill, fill_price feeds the cash basis, fill_size_pct feeds FillDeltaNormalizer.running_net) contracts. Orphaned-fix pattern (fixed one triad member, left two). FIX: mirror av1 — reject bool before the numeric coercion/ladder-check in both Proposal.__post_init__ and Fill.__post_init__. Scope: pdr_core/contracts.py only. NEW (av1 critique).

|| RESOLVED-MERGED 2026-06-15 (commit 56888e1). Proposal.target_position_pct + Fill.fill_price/fill_size_pct now reject bool (isinstance guard before the ladder/finiteness checks), mirroring av1's AnalystView fix. Valid float byte-identical; av1+fl1 guards untouched. 37 tests green. NEW cs83 (off-type non-float stored) + cs84 (normalizer dict-path orphans the Fill guards).

title: pdr_core Proposal.target_position_pct (and Fill price/size) STORE an off-type non-float (str/Decimal/numpy) that float()-coerces past the check but breaks downstream arithmetic — the cs82 bool-guard does not close it
description:
VERIFIED (cs82 critique, numeric). Proposal.__post_init__ validates only via _on_ladder, which does v=float(value) internally — so a string '0.05', Decimal('0.05'), or numpy float passes the ladder check but the FROZEN dataclass STORES the original off-type value unchanged. Proposal(target_position_pct='0.05') constructs with target_position_pct == str '0.05'. Downstream `p.target_position_pct * nav` -> TypeError (can't multiply sequence) or `p.target_position_pct < 0` -> TypeError (str < int) = a money-path crash; Decimal/numpy = silent type mismatch. Same for Fill.fill_price/fill_size_pct (float()-coerce-and-check but store raw). The docstring declares these typed `float`. Sibling of cs82 (bool) — the non-float-type completion. FIX (contracts.py only, frozen dataclass): after the cs82 bool guard, either reject non-int/float types before the numeric check, OR coerce-and-store a real float via object.__setattr__ so the stored value byte-matches the declared float contract. A genuine float is byte-identical. Scope: pdr_core/contracts.py only. NEW (cs82 critique).

|| RESOLVED-MERGED 2026-06-15 (commit on branch; cs83 fix). Proposal.target_position_pct + Fill.fill_price/fill_size_pct + AnalystView.magnitude/confidence/confidence_raw now reject non-(int,float) types (str/Decimal/np.float32) after the cs82 bool guard, so the frozen dataclass no longer STORES an off-type value that float()-coerced past the check. np.float64 (float subclass) passes; valid float/int byte-identical. The AnalystView off-type sibling is covered by this same fix (all 3 contracts). 59+436 tests green.

title: FillDeltaNormalizer production dict-fold path (delta_for/_absolute_size_of/_quantity_of) calls float(fill_size_pct)/float(quantity) on RAW executions.jsonl dicts with NO bool/NaN/string guard — the fl1+cs82 Fill-contract guards are ORPHANED on the actual money-path (it never sees Fill objects)
description:
VERIFIED (cs82 critique, numeric, P1). fl1 added Fill.__post_init__ finiteness guards EXPLICITLY because 'a NaN fill_size_pct poisons FillDeltaNormalizer.running_net' — but the normalizer's ACTUAL fold path (state/fill_delta_normalizer.py) consumes RAW executions.jsonl DICTS via portfolio_state.py:662 (rebuild) + :979 (incremental) under HERMES_QUANT_DELTA_NORMALIZER, NEVER Fill objects, so Fill.__post_init__ (and thus fl1's NaN guard + cs82's bool guard) NEVER RUNS there. delta_for (:168) does float(rec.get('fill_size_pct',0.0)); _absolute_size_of (:99) + _quantity_of (:149) do float(q)/float(rec[...]) with no isinstance(bool)/isfinite guard. VERIFIED: delta_for({'fill_size_pct':True}) returns 1.0 (100% NAV target from a bool); delta_for({'fill_size_pct':NaN}) returns NaN AND poisons running_net so the NEXT valid 0.05 fill in that bucket also returns NaN FOREVER (the exact poisoning fl1 cited); delta_for({'fill_size_pct':'0.05'}) coerces silently; reactor_metadata.quantity=True similarly. The Fill-contract guards are ORPHANED on the production fold (it validates Fill OBJECTS the fold never constructs). P1: a NaN/bool/string in a raw bus record poisons running_net -> state.db NAV (the gate-sized money figure) on the live rebuild/incremental fold whenever DELTA_NORMALIZER is on. FIX: add the SAME isfinite + isinstance(bool)-reject + numeric-coerce guards INSIDE the normalizer dict-path (delta_for/_absolute_size_of/_quantity_of) where it reads raw dict values — abstain/skip a non-finite/bool/non-numeric record (silence-by-default) rather than float()-coercing it into running_net. Scope: state/fill_delta_normalizer.py only. Sibling of fl1/cs82 (the guard-at-the-dict-boundary, not the object boundary). NEW (cs82 critique).

|| RESOLVED-MERGED 2026-06-15 (commit 4277343). FillDeltaNormalizer now routes the three raw-dict float() sites (delta_for/_absolute_size_of/_quantity_of) through a single _coerce_size guard (reject bool, then non-Real, then non-finite -> _PoisonedSizeError), closing the orphaned fl1/cs82 guard on the production fold (which consumes raw executions.jsonl dicts, never Fill objects). A NaN/bool/string fill_size_pct no longer poisons running_net/state.db NAV; fail-CLOSED via the existing rebuild-skip (:672) + incremental-rollback (:1082). Flag-OFF + valid-numeric byte-identical; ms1/cs64 untouched. 25 tests green. NEW cs85 (dual-map vs single-column mixed-lane fold divergence).

title: FillDeltaNormalizer mixed-LANE same-bucket fold divergence: dual _net_qty/_net_pct maps (rebuild) vs the single persisted old_qty column (incremental) produce different deltas for the SAME record stream -> state.db NAV corruption
description:
VERIFIED (cs84 critique, numeric). DISTINCT from cs84 (value-coercion, fixed), ms1 (mixed-SCHEMA same-lane seeding, closed), i0a/cr00 (closed). fill_delta_normalizer.py keeps TWO running-net maps — _net_pct (:140) + _net_qty (:141) — and delta_for selects per-record (:167 `net_map = self._net_qty if qty is not None else self._net_pct`). So a bucket receiving a QUANTITY-lane fill then a fill_size_pct-LANE fill differences the pct fill against _net_pct=0 -> delta 0.05 (the qty-lane fill never advanced _net_pct). But the INCREMENTAL fold (portfolio_state.py:979 delta_from_net(record, old_qty), old_qty=float(row['quantity']) :960) reads ONE persisted positions-row column per (account,asset_class,symbol) — after the qty-lane fill that column is non-zero, so the pct fill differences against it -> a DIFFERENT delta. The rebuild (dual-map) and incremental (single-column) folds therefore produce different state.db NAV for the SAME mixed-lane record stream. P1 money-state fold divergence (the gate-sized NAV). Gated on HERMES_QUANT_DELTA_NORMALIZER (default-OFF) -> pre-flip latent. FIX: reconcile the running-net model — either the rebuild collapses to ONE net per (account,asset_class,symbol) bucket (matching the persisted single-column incremental), OR the incremental tracks per-lane net to match the rebuild; the two folds MUST share one net model. PROVE which is correct (the persisted positions row is the canonical single net, so the rebuild dual-map is likely the side to reconcile). Scope: fill_delta_normalizer.py (+ possibly the portfolio_state incremental seed). Sibling of ms1/cs84. NEW (cs84 critique).

|| RESOLVED-MERGED 2026-06-15 (commit d823ee5). FillDeltaNormalizer now keeps ONE running net per (account,asset_class,asset) bucket (collapsed the dual _net_pct/_net_qty maps), matching the canonical persisted positions.quantity single column the incremental fold reads — so a mixed-lane bucket (det-equity qty-lane fill then PaperReactor pct-lane fill) folds rebuild==incremental (was rebuild 0.05 vs incremental -9.95). OFF + single-lane byte-identical; cs64/ms1/cs84 preserved. The genuine unit-mixing (shares summed with NAV-fraction) is the SEPARATE cr00/cs31 unit-unification dependency (read-time mark-injection) — RECOMMENDED not forced (a unit conversion here would re-diverge the rebuild from the canonical column). 107 tests green. Completes the normalizer fold-consistency family (ms1 + cs84 + cs85).

title: quant-flag-inventory.py scanner MISSES ~10 flags read without an inline default (incl. money-path PORTFOLIO_CAPS/DISSENT_CAP/BROKER_BACKEND) + a global-constant-collision bug drops MONTHLY_META_RETRO/INSIDER_ENABLED
description:
FILED by the ra09 lane (wskowi3jx). The flag SoT generator scan() captures inline `environ.get(FLAG, default)` + const-bound `FOO='FLAG'; environ.get(FOO, default)` but its regexes HARD-REQUIRE a default group + are not re.DOTALL, so it SILENTLY MISSES ~10 flags read as `environ.get('X')=='1'` (no default) or multi-line: PORTFOLIO_CAPS (autonomous.py:551, the gross/net/cash clip — MONEY-PATH), DISSENT_CAP (bma.py:1087, BMA decision gate), BROKER_BACKEND (backend.py:149, broker selector), REGIME_HMM, IC_DEDUP_AT_INGEST, TICK_LOCK_TIMEOUT_S, EVIDENCE_DIR, LLM_BUDGET_DIR, HOME, ALPHA_ZOO_DIR. SEPARATELY, a GENUINE BUG: scan() builds a SINGLE global consts dict keyed by bare NAME across all files (last-write-wins), so ENV_FLAG (meta_retro.py MONTHLY_META_RETRO vs regime_aware_confidence.py ANALYSTS_USE_REGIME) and _FLAG (form4.py INSIDER_ENABLED vs point_in_time.py PIT_UNIVERSE) COLLIDE -> MONTHLY_META_RETRO + INSIDER_ENABLED are silently DROPPED and ANALYSTS_USE_REGIME's source line is WRONG. FIX (agent-doable, ~scoped to ops/scripts/quant-flag-inventory.py): (a) resolve consts PER-FILE not globally (simulated: 55->57, recovers the 2 dropped, loses nothing); (b) add a no-default capture pattern (environ.get('X') with no default -> mark required/membership) + re.DOTALL; re-run --write; the drift test stays the gate. Money-software relevance: an operator must not read '55 flags' as 'every live toggle' when PORTFOLIO_CAPS (a cap rail) is missing. P2.

|| RESOLVED 2026-06-16 (TDD, RED->GREEN): fixed scan() in ops/scripts/quant-flag-inventory.py — (a) per-file constant resolution (was a single global consts dict, last-write-wins -> ENV_FLAG/_FLAG collisions silently dropped MONTHLY_META_RETRO + INSIDER_ENABLED + mis-attributed ANALYSTS_USE_REGIME's source); (b) two NO-DEFAULT capture patterns (_INLINE_NODEF environ.get('X') + _VIA_CONST_NODEF environ.get(CONST)) so money-path toggles read as `== '1'` / `or ''` are captured (PORTFOLIO_CAPS the cap rail, DISSENT_CAP the BMA gate, BROKER_BACKEND the selector). With-default always WINS over no-default (a literal default never overwritten). Flag count 55 -> 66 (the 11 previously-missed). NEW tests/ops/test_flag_inventory_completeness.py (4 tests, RED-proven) pins the money-path captures + the collision recovery + with-default precedence. Regenerated FLAG-INVENTORY.md (--check current at 66); the ra09 drift gate + deploy-audit-exclusions stay green; ruff clean; deterministic. The flag SoT is now COMPLETE (an operator reading the inventory now sees every live toggle incl. the cap rails).

title: HaltStateSQLite.add_halt cross-process check-then-insert race -> emergency-stop crashes before the bus halt-signal
description: FOUND + FIXED by archaeology wave-2 (wf_45b3b8cf). add_halt did a cross-PROCESS check-then-insert on an autocommit connection (isolation_level=None), serialized only by a process-local threading.RLock — NO BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Two concurrent emergency-stops/halts collided on the UNIQUE PK; the loser raised sqlite3.IntegrityError (or OperationalError on busy-timeout), neither a ValueError, so cli/halts.py cmd_emergency_stop's `except ValueError` let it escape as an unhandled CRASH BEFORE the Step-2 bus halt-signal — defeating the documented HALT-FIRST ordering. RED-reproduced (2-process mp.Barrier: loser raised IntegrityError; CLI crashed on OperationalError). FIX: (1) wrap add_halt's SELECT+SELECT+INSERT in BEGIN IMMEDIATE (mirror state/portfolio_state.py:910) so the 5s busy_timeout serializes the loser, which then hits the existing 'active halt already exists' ValueError guard; (2) broaden cmd_emergency_stop to catch sqlite3.Error and CONTINUE the HALT-FIRST sequence (the winner's halt is committed; we still emit our bus signal), and cmd_halt to report contention non-zero (not crash). Byte-identical single-process. +3 RED->GREEN tests (incl. the multiprocess race); 49 halt/governance regression tests green; ruff clean.

title: PortfolioState.reconstruct_from reads the bus OUTSIDE its BEGIN IMMEDIATE -> a concurrent fill is permanently lost (corrupts state.db equity_total)

Reachable via the operator scripts quant-ledger-reconcile.py + quant-flatten-paper-default.py. RED-reproduced (MSFT lost). FIX (preferred option): moved the bus read + replay INSIDE the BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction so the snapshot+rebuild is atomic w.r.t. concurrent apply_execution (which now correctly blocks on the write lock). Single-writer reconcile byte-identical (138 reconstruct/state/normalizer regression tests green). RED->GREEN read-under-lock probe test (non-vacuous: FAILS on pre-fix). ruff clean.

title: DrawdownBaselineStore.reconcile cross-process peak lost-update lowers the durable HWM below the true peak (fail-OPEN on the drawdown breaker)
description:

Reachable behind default-OFF HERMES_QUANT_DURABLE_DRAWDOWN_BASELINE=1 (cs86) with two processes gating one account concurrently. RED-reproduced (forced interleave: final peak 120 < true 150). FIX: wrap reconcile's SELECT+upsert in BEGIN IMMEDIATE (mirror portfolio_state.py:910 + ar04) so the loser reads the winner's committed peak. title: ADR-0016 D9 kill-switch P&L basis understated ~1000x (qty is NAV-fraction but code multiplies by entry_price then /NAV) — realized drawdown NEVER trips (P1 fail-OPEN)

But rt.qty IS the NAV-FRACTION magnitude (abs(fill_size_pct), settlement_loop _normalize_exec_record:496), NOT shares. Correct contribution = realized_return*qty (NAV cancels). The extra *entry_price /nav double-discounts ~nav/entry_price (~1000x). RED-VERIFIED EMPIRICALLY: a 50%-NAV position down 20% (= -10% of NAV realized = the default kill threshold) computes frac=-0.0001 vs correct -0.10; trip check _cum_pnl<=-0.10 reads False -> the secondary realized-drawdown rail FAILS OPEN on every NAV-fraction lane (autonomous + alpaca-paper). The correct fix is incremental settlement with a persisted open-lots carry-in checkpoint (join_exit_fills already accepts carry-in open_lots) — a genuine increment needing its own design+tests. Owner: agent, next dedicated increment. Re-open when the bus approaches a size where per-tick full-read latency matters, or as a planned hardening increment.

|| CLOSED 2026-06-16 (built+landed 487cbd0, NOT deferred — on the LIVE always-on §D9 rail): compute_cumulative_realized_pnl_pct reads only bytes past a durable checkpoint sidecar (atomic tmp+fsync+rename: byte-offset/carry-in open_lots/accumulated fraction/inode/prefix-fingerprint/max-asof-ns/normalizer-flag), threads open_lots into join_exit_fills, falls back to full replay on missing/corrupt checkpoint, bus shrink/rotation, normalizer-flag flip, or out-of-order late asof. title: trip_kill_switch fsyncs the file fd but NOT the parent dir — a crash after os.replace reverts the trip (ADR-0016 §D9 fail-OPEN)
body: Found by the atomic-write-durability FAMILY-COMPLETENESS sweep after wave-6 fixed the journal (538b2f6) + artifacts (8e69840) instances. trip_kill_switch (autonomous.py:519, the ADR-0016 §D9 kill-switch writer = highest-stakes money-state file) fsync'd only the file fd, not the parent dir after os.replace. POSIX: fsync(file) flushes DATA but not the directory ENTRY the rename created; a power-loss after os.replace can revert the rename -> the kill-switch reads PRE-trip on reboot = FAIL-OPEN on a safety rail (system trips at -12% drawdown, loses power, restarts NOT-tripped). FIX (ar86): fsync the parent dir (os.open O_RDONLY + fsync), best-effort warn-on-failure, matching the canonical wave-6 pattern. RED-verified (any([False]) pre-fix) -> GREEN (2/2 ar86 + 129 kill-switch regression). The atomic-write family is now swept across journal/artifacts/kill-switch; the remaining os.replace sites (watchlist/halt_state JSON-mirror/cache/fundamentals) are non-kill-switch — halt_state is a SQLite-truth mirror, the others are caches rebuilt on miss.
